verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity documents server-side VerificationSession creation (type=document), a Stripe-provided conversion-optimized capture flow with selfie matching, hosted static links and a modal web integration, and result retrieval via API and webhooks. Community users corroborate the turnkey UX, including the desktop-to-phone handoff and in-browser analysis. Missing for 10: the redirect-versus-embed mechanics are only thinly evidenced, via a static-link mention and a modal integration guide URL, with no detailed quote on redirect URLs or embed SDK calls.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch a complete document-plus-selfie verification with a hosted or drop-in flow — create a session server-side, redirect or embed, and read the result — without building capture UI myself
